```{r setup}
# Load packages ----------------------------------------------------------------
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(BiocParallel)
  library(yaml)
  library(DT)
  library(writexl)
  library(edgeR)
  library(limma)
  library(unikn)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(patchwork)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(RColorBrewer)
  library(tibble)
  library(tidyr)
  library(knitr)
  library(stringr)
  library(purrr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(data.table)

})

# Load functions ---------------------------------------------------------------
source("../../scripts/functions.R", local = TRUE)
source("../../scripts/GSEA_camera.R")
source("../../scripts/makeFitObject.R")

# Load globals -----------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(params$seed)

msigdb_dir <- "../../references/MSigDb_2025.1/"

de_table_cols <- c(
  "GENEID", "SYMBOL", "logFC", "logCPM", "F", "PValue", "FDR"
)

round_de_table_cols <- c(
  "logFC", "logCPM", "F", "PValue", "FDR"
)

shiny_path <- file.path(
  params$rds_dir, "shiny", "rds"
)
```

# Load data

```{r load-data}
dat <- as.data.frame(fread(file.path(params$data_dir, "beataml_waves1to4_counts_dbgap.txt")))
meta_clinic <- fread(file.path(params$data_dir, "beataml_wv1to4_clinical.csv"))
meta_sample <- fread(file.path(params$data_dir, "beataml_waves1to4_sample_mapping.csv"))
cnts <- as.matrix(dat[, grep("BA", colnames(dat))])

meta_clinic <- meta_clinic[meta_clinic$dbgap_rnaseq_sample %in% colnames(cnts) &
                             meta_clinic$dxAtInclusion == "ACUTE MYELOID LEUKAEMIA (AML) AND RELATED PRECURSOR NEOPLASMS", ]
cnts_aml <- cnts[, colnames(cnts) %in% meta_clinic$dbgap_rnaseq_sample ]
meta_clinic <- meta_clinic[match(colnames(cnts_aml), meta_clinic$dbgap_rnaseq_sample), ]
meta_sample <- meta_sample[meta_sample$dbgap_rnaseq_sample %in% colnames(cnts) &
                             meta_sample$rna_control ==  "Healthy pooled CD34+"]
cnts_healthy <- cnts[, colnames(cnts) %in% meta_sample$dbgap_rnaseq_sample]
meta_sample <- meta_sample[match(colnames(cnts_healthy), meta_sample$dbgap_rnaseq_sample), ]

grp <- data.frame(
  OriginalSampleName = c(colnames(cnts_aml), colnames(cnts_healthy)),
  Condition = c(rep("AML", ncol(cnts_aml)), rep("Healthy", ncol(cnts_healthy)) ),
  sex = "NA",
  CellLine = "NA",
  SampleGroup =  c(rep("AML", ncol(cnts_aml)), rep("Healthy", ncol(cnts_healthy)) )
)
grp$Condition <- factor(grp$Condition, levels = c("Healthy", "AML"))
grp$SampleGroup <- factor(grp$SampleGroup, levels = c("Healthy", "AML"))

gnes <- data.frame(
  Symbol = dat$display_label,
  GENEID = dat$stable_id,
  DESCRIPTION = dat$description,
  SYMBOL = dat$display_label
)

rownames(gnes) <- gnes$GENEID

dge <-  DGEList(counts = cbind(cnts_aml, cnts_healthy),
                samples =grp,
                genes = gnes)
rownames(dge$genes) <- dge$genes$GENEID
rownames(dge) <- dge$genes$GENEID

gene_sets <- readRDS(file.path(params$msigdb_dir, "msigdb_v2025.1.Hs_gene_sets.rds"))
```

# Create design matrix

```{r design}
moma <- model.matrix(~ 0 + SampleGroup, data = dge$samples)
colnames(moma) <- sub("SampleGroup", "", colnames(moma))
```

# Transform and filter data

```{r filter-transform-counts}
dge <- dge[filterByExpr(dge, design = moma), , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
dge <- dge[filterByExpr(dge), , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
```

# Calculate normalization factors and dispersions

```{r calculate-norm-factors-dispersions}
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)
dge <- estimateDisp(dge, design = moma)
log2cpm <- cpm(dge, log = TRUE, prior.count = params$prior_count)
```

# Create contrasts

```{r contrasts}
contrast_vec <- c("AML__vs__Healthy" = "AML - Healthy")

cntrs <- makeContrasts(
  contrasts = contrast_vec,
  levels = moma
)
colnames(cntrs) <- names(contrast_vec)
```

# Fit model and contrasts

```{r contrast-fit}
fits <- map(
  colnames(cntrs),
  ~ perform_contrast_fit_edgeR(fit, .x, cntrs)
) |> rlang::set_names(colnames(cntrs))
```

# GSEA analysis

```{r}
rownames(dge) <- dge$genes$GENEID
```

```{r gsea}
collections <- unique(sort(gene_sets$collection_name)) |>
  rlang::set_names()

fits <- map(fits, ~ add_camera_stats(.x, eset = dge))

gsea_res <- map(collections, function(co, gene_sets) {
  gs <- as.list(gene_sets[gene_sets$collection_name == co, "ensembl"])
  map(fits, ~ perform_gsea(.x, gs))
}, gene_sets = gene_sets, .progress = params$interactive)
```

# Heme synthesis

```{r}
library(GSVA)
library(msigdbr)
```

## Enrichment score

```{r export-gsea-tables, eval=params$run_gsea}
gsea_res_dfr <- lapply(names(gsea_res), function(x) {
  lapply(names(gsea_res[[x]]), function(y) {
    gsea_res[[x]][[y]] |>
      tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "Pathway") |>
      mutate(Contrast = y, .before = 1) |>
      mutate(MsigDb = x, .before = 1)
  }) |>
    bind_rows()
}) |>
  bind_rows()

write.table(
  gsea_res_dfr,
  file.path(
    params$table_dir,
    paste0("gsea_all.txt")
  ),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)

write_xlsx(
  gsea_res_dfr,
  file.path(
    params$table_dir,
    paste0("gsea_all.xlsx")
  )
)

write_xlsx(
  gsea_res_dfr |>
    dplyr::filter(FDR < params$pathway_fdr_threshold),
  file.path(
    params$table_dir,
    paste0("gsea_sig.xlsx")
  )
)
```

```{r export-for-shiny, eval=params$run_gsea}
if (!dir.exists(shiny_path)) {
  dir.create(shiny_path, recursive = TRUE)
}

saveRDS(dge, file = file.path(shiny_path, "expression_set.rds"))

log2cpm <- cpm(dge, log = TRUE, prior.count = params$prior_count)
iqrs <- apply(log2cpm, 1, IQR)
varCut <- 0.75
sel <- iqrs > quantile(iqrs, varCut)
pca <- prcomp(
  scale(t(scale(t(log2cpm[sel, ]), scale = FALSE)), scale = FALSE),
  center = FALSE
)
saveRDS(pca, file = file.path(shiny_path, "expression_set_pca.rds"))

cor_df <- expression_set_correlation(log2cpm)
saveRDS(
  cor_df,
  file = file.path(shiny_path, "expression_set_correlation.rds")
)

saveRDS(fits, file = file.path(shiny_path, "limma_results.rds"))

saveRDS(
  makeFitObject(fits),
  file = file.path(shiny_path, "limma_results_shiny.rds")
)

description_details <- c(
  "AML vs Healthy samples"
)

cn_descr <- data.frame(
  row.names = names(fits),
  description = if (exists("description_details") && !is.null(description_details)) {
    description_details
  } else {
    contrast_vec
  },
  coefficient = "",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

saveRDS(
  cn_descr,
  file = file.path(shiny_path, "contrast_description.rds")
)

if (any(lapply(gsea_res, length) > 0)) {
  saveRDS(
    gsea_res,
    file = file.path(shiny_path, "camera_results.rds")
  )
}
```
